title: caDIY3D V4 Project File Format (.cadiy4)
description: JSON Schema definition for caDIY3D V4 project file format (.cadiy4).

thumbnail.description: Data URL containing a base64-encoded WebP thumbnail of the scene (e.g. 'data:image/webp;base64,...'). May be empty.

revision.description: Sequential edit revision counter or timestamp of the scene state.

objects.description: List of 3D objects, materials, dimensions, fasteners, images, and annotations in the scene.

layers.description: List of layer/folder structures in the scene.

activeLayerId.description: Identifier of the currently active/selected layer for authoring.

selectedIds.description: List of UUIDs of objects currently selected in the viewport.

pictureImageTable.description: Table of embedded reference images (compressed/encoded) referenced by picture objects via imageBase64Id.

polygonMeshTable.description: Collection of polygon mesh geometry definition data keyed by internal mesh ID or stored as a table array.

oneOf.description: Dictionary of polygon mesh geometry definition data keyed by internal mesh ID.

Vector3.description: 3D Cartesian coordinate, vector, or dimension in meters or degrees.

x.description: X component in meters or degrees

y.description: Y component in meters or degrees (up axis)

z.description: Z component in meters or degrees (front axis)

Quaternion.description: Rotation represented as a unit quaternion.

ColorRGB.description: RGB color with normalized floating-point components [0.0, 1.0].

ColorRGBA.description: RGBA color with normalized floating-point components [0.0, 1.0].

BoundingBox3D.description: 3D Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) in world space coordinates (meters).

Camera.description: 3D viewport camera position and target orientation.

id.description: Layer unique identifier (0 is the root layer).

parentId.description: Parent layer ID, or null for root-level layers.

EdgeCut.description: Edge chamfer / corner cut processing definition for lumber and board (形状加工).

edgeIndex.description: 0-based edge index (0..11) of the bounding box/part to apply cut processing.

mode.description: Edge cut mode ('cut' for straight chamfer/angled cut, 'round' for curved fillet).

faceADist.description: Cut offset distance in meters along the adjacent face A.

faceBDist.description: Cut offset distance in meters along the adjacent face B.

radius.description: Corner rounding radius in meters (for round mode).

SourceMaterial.description: Origin stock material specifications preserved before boolean operations.

DimensionMeasure.description: Exact coordinate measurement details for dimension entity.

start.description: Measurement starting coordinate point in world space.

end.description: Measurement ending coordinate point in world space.

side.description: Direction normal vector of extension lines.

offset.description: Offset distance along side vector in meters.

CutLayoutItem.description: Placement layout definition of a cut part on a stock material piece.

baseId.description: Zero-based index of the stock material piece within its material standard group.

partsId.description: UUID referencing the scene object (objects[*].id) placed on this stock piece.

x.description: Offset along the X axis (width direction) on the stock material in meters. Set to 0 for 1D lumber/cylinders.

z.description: Offset along the Z axis (length direction) on the stock material in meters, accounting for preceding parts and blade kerf.

CutList.description: Woodworking cut plan (材料取り図 / 木取り図) parameters and stock layout mappings.

cutWidthMm.description: Saw blade kerf width in millimeters (typical default: 3mm).

layouts.description: List of cut part placements on stock materials generated by the cut plan.

id.description: Unique image ID referenced by picture object imageBase64Id.

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded image binary data (typically zlib deflate compressed).

PolygonMeshItem.description: Polygon mesh table item containing mesh geometry definition with its identifier.

vertices.description: Flat array of vertex coordinate components [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, ...].

faces.description: Flat array of triangle vertex index triplets [i0, j0, k0, i1, j1, k1, ...].

SceneObject.description: Generic 3D scene entity (lumber, board, cylinder, fasteners, images, annotations, dimensions, etc.).

id.description: Internal unique identifier (UUID v4 format or 'legacy-XXX').

partName.description: Optional individual label of the part (e.g. 'Table Top', 'Left Leg').

position.description: Bounding box center coordinates in world space (meters).

size.description: Local dimensions in meters. Lumber/Cylinder: z is length, x/y is cross section. Board: y is thickness, x is width, z is length.

textureId.description: Texture index (0: flat color, 1: wood grain lumber, 2: wood grain board, etc.).

displayId.description: User visible sequential part number shown on screen.

rotationDeg.description: Euler rotation angles in degrees [x, y, z].

noAggregated.description: Whether this part is excluded from cut plan and BOM parts list aggregation.

cutAngles.description: 8 cut angle values in degrees [0..7] for miters/bevels on ends.

edgeCuts.description: List of edge cut/chamfer processing operations applied to the part (形状加工).

specificGravity.description: Material density / specific gravity (e.g. 0.4 for SPF lumber).

auxLinePattern.description: Auxiliary extension line pattern style (0: solid).

textVisible.description: Whether the text label is shown.

valuePosition.description: Positioning of dimension measurement text ('top', etc.).

billboard.description: Whether annotation continuously faces the active camera.

measure.description: Exact coordinate measurement details for dimension entity.

text.description: Text string content for textBoard and comment.

contentRotation.description: Rotation of content text or image in degrees (0, 90, 180, 270).

arrowPoint.description: Target point that the comment arrow points to in world coordinates.

angle.description: Measured angle in degrees for protractor (0..180).

thickness.description: Thickness in meters for waveBoard, tube, or steelProfile.

subType.description: Sub-type classification (e.g. 'sineSmall' for waveBoard, 'pvc' for tube).

modelName.description: Relative file path of imported 3D mesh (e.g. 'Doll Model/Adult 170cm.dmesh').

meshRef.description: Reference key to mesh entry in polygonMeshTable.

snapVertices.description: Array of local snap point vertex coordinates.

vertices.description: Geometry vertex buffer (flat array of numbers, array of Vector3, or raw string data).

faces.description: Geometry face topology buffer (indices or polygon face structures, or raw string data).

sourceMaterials.description: Origin stock material specifications preserved before boolean operations.

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded image data string for picture entity.

aspectRatioFixed.description: Whether image aspect ratio is locked during scaling.

diameterIndex.description: Screw nominal diameter preset index (e.g. 6 for 3.8mm, 8 for 4.2mm).

screwLength.description: Screw shaft length in meters (e.g. 0.04 for 40mm).

showDimension.description: Whether to display fastener dimension indicator.

screwColor.description: Hex color code for screw head/body (e.g. '#c0c0c0').

lineColor.description: Hex color code for auxiliary guide lines (e.g. '#000000').

linePattern1.description: Line pattern style for axis center line.

linePattern2.description: Line pattern style for auxiliary extension line.

screwPosition.description: Position offset index or ratio along fastener guide line.
